description: This file defines a custom Android TV presentation component called CardPresenter, which displays media items as cards with poster images and content descriptions. It manages view creation, data binding using Glide, focus animations, and view cleanup.

classes.name: CardPresenter
classes.description: A custom Presenter for Android TV that displays media items as interactive image cards with focus animations.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view holder containing an ImageView for displaying media posters.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a MediaItem to the ImageView, setting the content description and loading the poster image via Glide.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears Glide resources and resets view properties for reuse.
